    about
    John Morgan
    American attorney
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    John Morgan is a prominent Florida-based personal injury attorney and founder of the national law firm Morgan & Morgan, often cited as the largest in the U.S.. A billionaire, he is known for backing medical marijuana initiatives and is currently proposing a new, third political party in Florida, offering $100K for a winning party name. 
    Key Information: John Morgan (Attorney) 
    • Morgan & Morgan: Founded in 1988, the firm has over 1,000 attorneys, 50+ practice areas, and has recovered over $30 billion for clients.
    • Political Activity: Known as a major Democratic fundraiser and "godfather" of Florida’s medical marijuana amendment.
    • Current Endeavors (2026):
      Recently stated he is not running for Florida Governor but is seeking to create a new third political party, launching a contest with a $100,000 prize for the best name.
    • Background: Often resides in Hawaii and is a vocal advocate for marijuana legalization. 
    Other People Named John Morgan 
    • John Morgan (Country Singer): A country music artist and songwriter signed to Jason Aldean's label, known for writing hit songs like "Trouble with a Heartbreak" and releasing the album Carolina Blue.
    • John Morgan (1842-1894): A historic Mormon missionary who established a colony in Georgia and was president of the Southern States Mission. 
    Note: The results indicate a high-profile attorney (John Bryan Morgan) and a distinct country singer (John Morgan).
